events.did: 露台独处时的长段表白：她不在乎公爵夫人的认可或任何人的认可，她在乎的是彼此，以及将要一起创造的生活；她把辛西娅的手引到自己的腰、拉近；她知道自己也许永远不能在舞厅里与海伦娜共舞、不能在海德公园散步时接吻、不能在亲友与神父面前宣告爱意；但她会爱她一生——「无论在秘密里还是在丑闻里，在阳光里还是在阴影里，在欢乐里还是在悲伤里」
events.verbatim: ‘I don’t care about her approval. Or anyone else’s. I care about you, and me, and the life we will create together.’ … ‘We might never be able to dance together in a ballroom, or kiss while walking in Hyde Park, or declare our love in front of a priest and all our friends and family. But I will love you for the rest of my days, Helena Blair. Whether in secret, or in scandal, in sunlight or shadows, in joy or sorrow.’

events.did: 回应：她们有美丽与冒险，还有无数个共度的夜晚；还有早晨与下午；他们永远不会懂这样的魔法；「现在，在这星空下，以月光为证，以夜莺的旋律，你愿意与我共舞吗，我的爱人」；辛西娅答「那将是我最大的荣幸」
events.verbatim: ‘We have beauty and adventure, and endless nights together. And mornings. And afternoons. They will never understand such magic. And now, under these stars, witnessed by the moonlight, and to the melody of the nightingale, will you dance with me, my love?’ … ‘It would be my greatest honour.’

events.who: 海伦娜／辛西娅／哈姆雷特
events.did: 全书最后画面：海伦娜双手搭在辛西娅腰上，辛西娅环住海伦娜的肩，两人随一支只为他们演奏的曲子摇摆，哈姆雷特像哨兵一样站着，守护两个心跳合一的女人
events.verbatim: Helena rested her hands on Cynthia’s hips. Cynthia wrapped her arms around Helena’s shoulders, and they swayed to a melody playing only for them as Hamlet stood sentinel, protecting the two women whose hearts beat as one.
